measurement_note: Received counters include drain time; throughput/goodput denominator is app_stop_s-app_start_s. Unreceived packets may still be queued if drain is insufficient. Delay/jitter are IP-level for received packets. No UL SINR is reported from DL traces.

metric_definitions.end_to_end_delay_ms: Mean IP-level delay from UE transmission to cloud reception, for received packets.
metric_definitions.jitter_ms: FlowMonitor sum of absolute consecutive packet delay differences / (received packets - 1), in ms.
metric_definitions.loss_fraction: (Transmitted packets - received packets) / transmitted packets after drain; may include packets still queued.
metric_definitions.throughput_mbps: Received IP bytes * 8 / application window / 1e6; includes IP/UDP headers and packets received during drain.
metric_definitions.undefined_metrics: null when there are insufficient packets or no matching flow.

scenario.link_condition_basis: Assumed unobstructed free-space link; no LOS/NLOS condition model is installed.
